title: Practice 1: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Let's go to the casino tomorrow.
exercises.why: **пошли** — past tense (plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: I went to help my dad.
exercises.why: **пошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
**повёл** — past tense (masculine) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».

exercises.q: Tom went to the park by himself.
exercises.why: **пошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: He didn't go and I didn't either.
exercises.why: **пошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: It began to rain toward evening.
exercises.why: **пошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
**пошли** — past tense (plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
**пошли** — past tense (plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
**пошла** — past tense (feminine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: The dog ran after a fox.
exercises.why: **побежала** — past tense (feminine) of побежать: the perfective of бежать, «set out».
**побежал** — past tense (masculine) of побежать: the perfective of бежать, «set out».
**пошло** — past tense (neuter) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
**поплыли** — past tense (plural) of поплыть: the perfective of плыть, «set out».
**пошли** — past tense (plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: I didn't go to the funeral.
exercises.why: **пошла** — past tense (feminine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
**побежал** — past tense (masculine) of побежать: the perfective of бежать, «set out».
**повела** — past tense (feminine) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».
**повёл** — past tense (masculine) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».
**побежали** — past tense (plural) of побежать: the perfective of бежать, «set out».

exercises.q: Mary went to her fitness class.
exercises.why: **пошла** — past tense (feminine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
